facts.title: balthazar’s cream of mushroom soup
ingredients: 1 ounce dried mushrooms (porcini, morels, or shitakes)
1 large yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced
3 garlic cloves, peeled and thinly sliced
1 pound white button or cremini mushrooms, cleaned and thinly sliced
1 pound shitake mushrooms stemmed, cleaned and thinly sliced
6 cups chicken stock, vegetable stock, or water
facts.author: Deb Perelman
